controls.expectation: The unchanged Tape check rejects an export that returns false for arrays and accepts the original export.

claims.behavior: The existing isarray checks accept the candidate.
claims.precondition: The existing npm lockfile dependencies are installed.
claims.expected: All 28 existing Tape assertions pass in both named cases, with no skips.
claims.case: Unchanged candidate and an isolated always-false export fault.
evidence: Tape output and command exit status

limits: Only the existing tests-only script is adopted. Lint and the network-backed npm posttest audit are not gates or claims.
Exit status is the check contract; the operator must inspect the retained Tape output for assertion counts and skips.
The case named only polyfill deletes Array.isArray after requiring the module. On this Node runtime it does not prove execution of the fallback export.
Legacy browser compatibility, package publication, browser behavior and human use are untested.
